method: pdftoppm full-page render + Read tool (Claude Code allotment; no Anthropic API)

contributions.detail: Generation 1 (Carr Printing 5-5-PG) - Form A prints NO schedule total, so the cover line is the only anchor (schedule_total null). Three rows 200.00 + 5000.00 + 100.00 = 5300.00, exactly the cover's line 1, which reads the same in the THIS REPORT and CUMULATIVE columns with 'Totals from last report' left blank - i.e. the filer's first report of the cycle, so the two scopes coincide. Cover line 2 (the $50-or-less aggregate) is left entirely blank on all three columns and is never itemized, so it plays no part in the reconciliation.

expenditures.detail: No printed schedule total on Form B either; the cover's line 3 is the only anchor. Sixteen rows sum to EXACTLY 2493.77. This gate did the real work: three superscript-cents cells were bistable at 200 dpi (137.8x/137.6x, 33.9x, 448.x8, 38.x5) and the ARITHMETIC - not the glyph re-read - pinned .97 on row 12 and .25 on row 15, after which the 1200 dpi glyph reads for rows 8 and 14 (.86 and .38) were the only pair consistent with the printed total. Rhodes discipline: the document's own arithmetic outranked the glyph.

gates.page_subtotal: NO printed schedule total exists on either Generation-1 schedule (both sheets end with '(If additional space is needed, use blank paper...)'), so the cover's own lines are the only anchors: p2 rows 5300.00 = cover line 1 (exact); p3 rows 2493.77 = cover line 3 (exact).
gates.row_count: rowbands.py p2: 36 bands over ~36 ruled writing lines, 3 inked -> 3 rows emitted. p3: 36 bands, 16 inked (bands 1-16, contiguous from the top) -> 16 rows emitted. Scored against INK, band-by-band, not by band count.
gates.geometry_proof: p2: first-row crop renders '10-1-09 Cory Pulsipher ... 200.00'; last(3rd)-row crop renders '2-17-10 Utah Bail Bond ... 100.00'; control one pitch below renders EMPTY (bare rules). p3: first-row amount crop renders '337.27'; last(16th)-row crop renders '75.00'; control one pitch below renders EMPTY.
gates.balance_chain: 5300.00 - 2493.77 = 2806.23 = the printed cover line 4 CUMULATIVE balance. Closes EXACTLY. No earlier filing by this filer in this cycle is in my chunk (the other Pulsipher document I hold is the 2018 cycle), so no cross-filing chain was available to run here.
